text: Dedaenc is a Dunmer Necromancer who resides in the St. Delyn Canton of Vivec City.
Deathlord Bjarfrud Skjoralmor is a Draugr boss that appears in . Bjarfrud Skjoralmor is the resurrected form of the original founder of Falkreath Hold, and serves as a boss in the dungeon.
Delvam Andarys is a Dunmer who resides in Mawia. Delvam is a necromancer and is wanted for his crimes. He will be hostile on sight, and can not be reasoned with. He carries the unique weapon Shimsil.
Diabolist Vethisa is a Dunmer necromancer and a member of Shadowed Path. She is found in the Pothole Caverns. This boss has a chance to drop Vethisa's Grips of Cyrodiil's Ward.
Diabolist Volcatia is an Imperial necromancer of the Shadowed Path found in the Haynote Cave.

Dravynea is a Dunmer and an Expert Alteration trainer who can be found in Kynesgrove in Eastmarch. She states that her job in the town is to help keep Steamscorch Mine safe for the workers by ensuring that the tunnels do not collapse. She seemingly came to Skyrim from Morrowind after the Red Mountain eruption along with many other Dunmer refugees.
Dralnas Moryon is a Dunmer soul shriven found at the entrance of The Wailing Maw. His soul was sucked out and stored into The Anguish Gem, which he wants to see destroyed.
Edgar Vautrine is a Breton spell merchant who can be found in his store, Edgar's Discount Spells, in the Imperial City Market District.
Ekkhi is a Nord battlemage who resides in the city of Ebonheart, Imperial Guard Garrison. She is a champion of the Imperial Legion.
Eligun the Serpent Lord is a powerful Maormer summoner and a member of the Sea Vipers found at the Serpent's Grotto. He is a boss that must be fought during the quest "The Serpent Lord."
Eeze of the Creeping Dusk is a Nord vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .

Emer Dareloth was the first Gray Fox and Guildmaster of the Thieves Guild during the Third Era. Dareloth was cursed by the Daedric Prince, Nocturnal, where he would be erased from history upon wearing the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. The Diary of Springheel Jak refers indirectly to Dareloth as "a great thief," though due to Nocturnal's curse, Jak could not remember his name.

Emperor Leovic was the last of a Reachman dynasty called the Longhouse Emperors, who ruled the Empire of Cyrodiil during the Interregnum. His corpse can be found in the Imperial Sewers, where it is being resurrected by Worm Cult necromancers.
Erandur-Vangaril is a lich found in Lost Boy Cavern, whose history is revealed in the quest (which does not appear in the Journal), the "Lich of Lost Boy Cavern."
Eraman is an Altmer necromancer. He takes part in conducting strange rituals with Quendia and Norendo at Soulfire Plateau.
Exarch Rouillac is a Breton vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Exarch Sanctus is an Imperial vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .

Falcar is an Altmer mage and head of the Cheydinhal Mages Guild chapter in the final years of the Third Era. Secretly, he is also a member of the Order of the Black Worm and a necromancer. Prior to the Attack on the Mages Guild by the Order, he served as an invaluable mole and later as one of Mannimarco's chief lieutenants.

Falion is a Redguard mage in who resides in Morthal. Before settling in the town, Falion was the Conjuration master at the College of Winterhold, a position now held by his former pupil Phinis Gestor. He left because he hated to have to report to Savos Aren, the Arch-Mage of the College, as well as disliking "where the College is headed," as Phinis says. He is also the brother of Morthal's innkeeper, Jonna. Due to Falion's association with Necromancy, the people of the town accuse him of all sorts of wrongdoings, such as killing children and eating the hearts of the dead. Falion takes care of an adopted orphan, Agni, and is also teaching her the ways of magic. He can be found wandering aroun
Falkyn Milkeye is a Nord agent of the Worm Cult who raised undead all over Fullhelm Fort.

Feremuzh is the leader of the Vampire coven found in the Coldrock Diggings. At one point in time, a group of Redguards fought him and brought down the mine to ensure that he would not be able to feed on Redguards anymore.
Fasef al-Iskour is a Redguard vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Gabrielle Benele is a Breton mage and a member of the Mages Guild residing in the Lion Guard Redoubt, Glenumbra. The Vestige first encounters her in the crypt at Merovec's Folly.
Gadinas is a Bosmer feral vampire who was captured by the coven found in the Shademist Moors in Greenshade.

Galur Rithari was a Dunmer member of the Buoyant Armigers before he was infected with vampirism and began hiding out in Ashalmawia, trying to find a cure or a way to escape this life, and keeping a journal in the process. His place of residence is located in Ashalmawia, a Daedric ruin in northwestern Vvardenfell.

Garron the Returned is a lich boss encountered in Wayrest Sewers II after defeating Uulgarg the Risen. Garron used the money he made from helping Master Pellingare to study necromancy, and used the resulting attack by the Lion Guard to turn himself into a lich.

Galthis, also known as the Night Terror, Omen of a Hundred Prophecies, and First Nightcaller, is a servant of Vaermina that appears in . He is known as her lover and most loyal servant. According to his autobiography, he was a Breton noble who became bored with his life, and decided to bring about a world of dreams by serving Vaermina. He aims to impersonate High King Emeric and the rip the Daggerfall Covenant apart, allowing the Supernal Dreamers to take over. He is fought in Emeric's Dream in the castle. In combat he appears as King Emeric, Sir Hughes, Hosni at-Tura, and General Godrun, before turning into a Bone Colossus.

Geirmund was an Arch-Mage of Windhelm in the early days of the First Era, during the reign of High King Harald. He fought against Mikrul, Jyrik, and Sigdis Gauldurson, the craven sons and murderers of Arch-Mage Gauldur. When Geirmund fell near Ivarstead while battling with Sigdis, the last of the brothers to be defeated, Harald ordered a Geirmund's Hall to be built for him on the nearby Lake Geir. Geirmund's corpse can still be found within, guarding that of Sigdis.

Gavros Plinius is an Imperial sorcerer and member of the Synod. He is encountered by the Dragonborn inside Mzulft, dying. He holds the key for the door that is locked which is essential for the quest to proceed.

Gellir was a Nordic High King of Skyrim in the First Era. Historians have attributed him as a master tactician in his wars against the Dwemer, during which several Dwemer cities, which had been able to held fast against Nords for hundread of years across Skyrim, fell to his armies. It is believed by Nord chroniclers that Gellir's talents were a blessing of the God Shor. While the Dwarves were fighting for the power of the Aetherium, causing internal conflicts, Gellir took the opportunity to conquer the Dwarven Cities within 3 years.
Giant Scorpion is a creature in . It has the ability to paralyze enemies, and it can be hit with any material.
Ghost of Galos Heleran is a named ancestor guardian who walks the halls of the Heleran Ancestral Tomb. He occasionally disturbs Nedhelas' House, which was built on top of it.

Gnaw Tooth is an Orsimer warlock who can be found in the right wing of Ald Daedroth in the Azura's Coast region. He is accompanied by Domba at the Daedric shrine to Lord Sheogorath, located on an island east of Mzuleft, and northeast of the Rotheran Stronghold. He is hostile and will readily engage in combat with any adversary in sight.

Golthog, also known as Golthog the Dark, was a Goblin rumored to be a necromancer that served the Underking. During the Imperial Simulacrum, Golthog and his band of goblins attacked the palace of Rihad in Hammerfell and stole much of their treasure, including a piece of parchment which contained clues to decipher the part of the Elder Scrolls which spoke of the location of Fang Lair. After this, he fled to an ancient and abandoned fortress outside the city, Stonekeep. This piece of parchment was eventually returned by the Eternal Champion.
Goris the Maggot King is a Dunmer necromancer, and resides in the Venim Ancestral Tomb.

Grivier Bloodcaller is a Reachman Necromancer world boss residing on the small island Balefire Island, Glenumbra. Defeating him and his bone colossus unlocks the the explorer achievement Grivier Hunter.

Guardian Torsten is a Draugr who can be found inside Ragnvald Canal. He must be killed in order to obtain one of the keys to unlock the sarcophagus of Dragon Priest Otar the Mad. He can be summoned by picking up his skull from the pedestal in the middle of the room.
Grurn is an undead Lich included with the Siege at Firemoth plug-in for who resides in the tomb under Fort Firemoth.
Gudrig gro-Murtag is an Orcish Shaman, "though he call[s] himself a wizard."
Hagravens are aggressive humanoid creatures with bird-like features found across Skyrim. Coming in contact with one can cause brain rot, a disease that lowers the victim's magicka.

Hara is a Redguard residing in Craglorn, Belkarth. She can be found in the Star-Gazers' Observatory. She leads the Star-Gazers' efforts in investigating the disappearance of the celestials in the sky. Hara was said to only have arrived in Craglorn for a short time, but the Star-Gazers turn to her for her immense knowledge concerning the stars and the constellations. Together with the Vestige, Titus Valerius and Kelmen Locke, they act as the champions of the Celestial Guardians in thwarting the Serpent's schemes.

Hermaeus Mora (), also known as Hoermius, Hormaius, Hermorah, Herma Mora, the Woodland Man, and the Gardener of Men, is the Daedric Prince of knowledge and memory. His sphere is the scrying of the tides of Fate, of the past and future as read in the stars and heavens. He is not known for being good or evil. Hermaeus Mora seems to be the keeper of both helpful and destructive knowledge, although he usually sees all seekers of any knowledge as his servants.

HoonDing (or Hoonding), also known as The Make Way God, is the Yokudan spirit of 'perseverance over infidels'. The HoonDing has historically materialized whenever the Redguards need to 'make way' for their people.
Igna is a Nord Barbarian, and Vampire who resides in Morrowind. She can be found in lower level of the Dwemer Ruins of Druscashti and is a member of the Quarra Vampire Clan.

Ildari Sarothril is a Dunmer necromancer who once served as an apprentice of Neloth, the Telvanni wizard who lives at Tel Mithryn on the island of Solstheim. She is encountered in Highpoint Tower during the quest Old Friends.
Idrasa is a Dunmer ghost found at Malak's Maw. She seeks help in achieving her revenge which requires the death of her murderer, Khralek gro-Vortag, a necromancer of the Oathbound Clan.
Izoufa the Red is a Redguard vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .

Javad Tharn is an Imperial member of House Tharn and is a nephew of Abnur Tharn. He serves as the main antagonist of the Reaper's March region. He is a necromancer and the leader of the Stonefire Cult. He is attempting to corrupt the Manes and thus the spirit of the Khajiiti people in order to force them out of the Dominion. He corrupted Mane Akkhuz-ri, forcing him to summon an army of Dro-m'Athra spirits to serve them.
Jaretius Illvina is an Imperial Necromancer found at the Arvina Estate. He is found with several raised skeletons, including that of his wife Vesta Illvina.
Jastia Berne is a character residing in Galom Daeus, in Vvardenfell. They are a Vampire, and a member of the Berne Clan.

Kellen is a Redguard commoner, found in the Chapel of Stendarr. Kellen is a descendant of Sir Casimir, one of the Knights of the Nine. While Sir Casimir was in the Chapel, he struck a beggar and killed him, this not only caused the Gauntlets of the Crusader to fall off his hands, but Stendarr also cursed Casimir and all his descendants.
Kerelia Lucullus is an Imperial member of the Worm Cult cell encountered in Trolhetta. She is found raising dead giants in order to unleash them on the Ebonheart Pact.
Kevinne Blightheart is the Reachman leader of the Boneshaper Clan.
King of Miscarcand is a unique lich encountered in Miscarcand during the quest of the same name.

Khoruzoth is an Orsimer found in the Thukhozod's Sanctum, Wrothgar. He is the son of Yazoga and Khrogur. Khoruzoth was born into the bloodline of the legendary necromancer Thukhozod. Despite the fact that Khrogur left Yazoga to raise Khoruzoth alone, because the Sanctum wasn't a place to raise children, he was eager to let his son to inherit the title of Thukhozod. The Thukhozod Sanctum was, however, overtaken by another eager necromancer Gorlar the Dark before Khoruzoth arrived. This resulted in an early death for the young Khoruzoth, when he came to finally see his father.
King Styriche of Verkarth is an immensely powerful Nedic vampire that is sometimes summoned at Dark Anchors across Tamriel along with his servants, Fangaril and Zayzahad.
Knight Ailex is an Imperial Vampire working for House Montclair found in the Fevered Mews just behind Shornhelm.

Kynareth, called Kyne by the Nords, Kin by the Kothringi, Khenarthi by the Khajiit and Tava by the Redguards, is a goddess of the Nine Divines. She is the strongest of the Sky spirits and is the deity of the heavens, the winds, the elements, and the unseen spirits of the air. Patron of sailors and travelers, Kynareth is invoked for auspicious stars at birth and for good fortune in daily life. In some legends, Kyne was the first to agree to Lorkhan's plan to invent the mortal plane, and provides the space for its creation in the void. She is also associated with rain, a phenomenon said not to occur before the removal of Lorkhan's divine spark. She is often associated with Zenithar, as Zenitha

Kud-Ei is an Argonian and resident of the town of Bravil. She serves the Mages Guild as head of Bravil Guildhall. She carries a leveled longsword strapped to her waist. Kud-Ei is also a journeyman Illusion trainer.

Kyne or Kaan (Dragon Language: ), also called the Mother of Men, the Mother of Nords, and the Widow of Shor, is the Nordic Goddess of Storm. She is considered the widowed warrior-wife of the god Shor by the Ancient Nordic Pantheon, and is held in the highest esteem by Atmoran and Nord hunters. It is believed by Nord tradition that Kyne leads souls to the afterlife of Sovngarde, earning her the moniker of Kiss at the End. She has most commonly been referred to as Kynareth, her name in the Imperial Pantheon, since the end of the Merethic Era.
Kraig the Graveborn is a Draugr raised by the Worm Cult members found in Vernim Woods.
Laelette is a Breton vampire residing in Morthal. She is the wife of Thonnir, and mother of Virkmund, and a servant of Alva.

Larina is an Imperial, who dies in Hob's Fall Cave. Larina stole Pantea Ateia's Flute, leading to her being sacrificed by the necromancers she tried to sell it to. The necromancers claimed to be reviving the Order of the Black Worm.
Lathriel the Pale is a powerful Bosmer Vampire, part of the trio ruling over the Shademist Moors.
Lamia Curare is a Lamia that appears in . They use spells in combat. Dead Lamia Curares are found within Arx Corinium.
Lady Famyne is a Dunmer necromancer and vampire. She makes her lair out of an abandoned farmstead located south of Cropsford.
Leidmir Corpse-Caller is a Nord Vampire in charge of the Montclair soldiers found inside Hildune's Secret Refuge.
Lerexus Novation is an undead merchant residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
Lieutenant Urien is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion investigating the necromantic activities ongoing in the Ossuary of Telacar.

Lorgren Benirus is a minor antagonist in and the original owner of Benirus Manor, the house for sale in Anvil. Velwyn Benirus, who is staying at The Count's Arms, offers the Hero the house for a surprisingly cheap amount. It is later revealed that Lorgren was a necromancer who experimented on his slaves and left their spirits to roam the house forever.
Lu'ah Al-Skaven is a Redguard necromancer residing at Ansilvund in Eastmarch.
Lorurmend is an Altmer witch and vampire who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.
Louna Darkblood is a Breton necromancer group boss residing in the ruins of Old Kalgon's Keep.
Macke of the Piercing Eyes was Harbinger of the Companions some time during the Second Era.
Madam Whim is a Dark Seducer residing in The House of Whims in Fargrave City District, Fargrave.

The Mantle of Woe is an enchanted robe worn by the necromancer Tymvaul in the Rimhull ice cave, located west of Skaal Village. Its wearer is the subject of the quest "Tymvaul in the Well." The robe can be obtained by killing Tymvaul, or by convincing him to take it off by speaking about his father, Lassnr.

Malana is a Nord former court mage trying to regain her position by banishing a powerful necromancer found in Hall of the Dead beneath Windhelm. Upon the finding of Lodorr's Crown, Malana reveals her true motives and attacks.

Malofar is a Nord mage found in Breagha-Fin. He settled there after him and his tribe were exiled from Skyrim for mysterious reasons. Shortly afterwards, he stole The Emerald Chalice, an artefact that was in the possession of the Mages Guild. Once they arrived in Breagha-Fin, he quickly became tired with his tribe and proceeded to turn them all into goblins.

Master Stormwarden Faranwe is an Ayleid spirit in that is encountered within the ruins of Ilayas. She was once the leader of the Stormwardens, a group dedicated to the safekeeping of the Sphere of Storms.

Marrec Hinault is a Breton hiding from rampaging bloodfiends with the rest of his family at their farm just outside Shornhelm. While the Vestige is out collecting weapons for them to defend themselves, the fiends managed to break into the farm house, killing the father Gennove and forcing the rest of the family to escape. When Marrec is found, he has already been turned into a bloodfiend himself and must be put down.

Medora Direnni, also called the Witch of Daggerfall, Lady of Balfiera, the Fairy Lady, and the Queen of Oblivion, is a Breton sorceress and member of the Direnni Clan. She lives in Direnni Tower, home of the Direnni Clan. She was the personal sorceress of King Lysandus of Daggerfall during the War of Betony. She became trapped in her home, the Direnni Tower, after Mynisera placed a curse on it. She can be located in Direnni Tower, and can be freed by completing the quest after completing Privateer's Hold.
Mazar the Vengeful is a powerful Skeleton found inside the Ruins of Kardala.

Melisande is a Breton Glenmoril witch that lives off the Corbolo River, south of Cheydinhal. She assists the Hero with the quest "Vampire Cure" after they help her find five Grand Soul Gems. Though previously part of the Glenmoril Coven, she is now a retiree.
Mercator Hosidus is the steward of Janus Hassildor, the Count of Skingrad. Besides being a rude servant, he is also a necromancer.

Mel Adrys is a vampire hunter of renown. He is first encountered in the Shademist Moors, where he is tracking down Faenir Blood-Letter, a vampire who has eluded him for years. He is later found again inside Hrota Cave, where he is trying to root out and destroy the vampire coven established inside.
Mikhail the Lost is an undead skeleton located in Skyreach Catacombs.
Midaras Centho is a Imperial necromancer. She was part of the Worm Cult cell found in Forelhost. She was slain by the draugr when they were awaken.

Mirmulnir (Dragon Language: Mir–Mul–Nir, "Allegiance–Strong–Hunt") is a dragon that attacks the Western Watchtower outside of Whiterun. He is a supporting antagonist of the main storyline and the first dragon in the main questline slain by a prisoner who escaped from Helgen, helping them discover their identity as the Last Dragonborn.

Mondrar Henim is a necromancer seen in the High Pasture, west of Skingrad. He is working with their undercover agent, Mercator Hosidus. While Count Janus Hassildor knows of Mercator's ties to Necromancy, he has been unable to attack without knowing who his allies were.

Morven Stroud is a ghostly merchant found within the Soul Cairn. He claims that he used to be one of the greatest merchants in High Rock, but accidentally sold fake ingredients to a person who worked for a coven of Necromancers, thus dooming him to the Soul Cairn.
Muldroni Rendas is a Dunmer Spellsword living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni.
N'Gasta was a powerful Sload necromancer. He created a spell called Soulsnare, and wrote the book N'Gasta! Kvata! Kvakis!. He was a servant of Clavicus Vile and Mannimarco.

Naris the Wicked is a necromancer found in Morvunskar, southwest of Windhelm. He is located at the bottom of a staircase behind a locked door. Upon discovering Naris, he will be standing in front of a prison cell, where he appears to have tortured prisoners to death by burning them alive. The mage who works the forge says he gets a kick out of torturing the prisoners.

Nchunak was a notable Dwemer. Nchunak believed in the theories of Kagrenac, that the Dwemer race should have the power of immortality by the use of the Heart of Lorkhan and the Numidium. He traveled among the many colonies of the Dwemer empire to teach the theories of Kagrenac.
Necromancer's Apprentice is a Dunmer Necromancers residing in the Skygge ice cave west of Skaal Village.
Nedrasa is a Dunmer skin-stealer. She is found in Ten-Maur-Wolk.

Nimphaneth is a Bosmer conjurer and cannibal residing in Reachcliff Cave in The Reach. During the Daedric Quest "The Taste of Death," she is revealed to be a cannibal and a member of the Coven of Namira.

Nhalan is a cursed Nedic star priest encountered in the Burial Ruins of Shada's Tear. He will assist the Vestige in cleansing the water and defeating the city's defenses, on the condition that they free him of his own curse.
Novice Necromancer is a low-leveled, hostile necromancer in who is encountered in various dungeons. They are mostly encountered wearing Necromancer's robes, with or without a hood.

Nu-Hatta is Khajiit moth priest of high station. He communed with the Inquiry Tree at Fort Sphinxmoth and reported his findings to Ocato and the Elder Council, predicting the Oblivion Crisis before it occurred.
Odanach the Graveborn is a Draugr raised by the Worm Cult members found in Vernim Woods.

Old Trinket is a character found in . He is a strange old man that the Hero of Azra's Crossing met for the first time outside of the Azra's Crossing village. The Hero's path crossed with him again in East Dragonstar. At that time, he was imprisoned in the Dragonstar Jail. Tanyin Aldwyr asks the Hero to release him. Later, Old Trinket is met again outside the Crypt of Hearts. He offers the Hero to teach them several combat tricks before they head inside.
Olphras is an undead skeleton that appears in . She was trapped under the Bone Orchard alongside her kin after the Bosmer people got scared of Dringoth.
Ormax Kirbatha is an Imperial vampire in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Overlord Nur-dro is a Khajiit vampire found leading his coven at Ushmal's Rest.

Padomay, also known as Fadomai, Padhome, or PSJJJJ, is a primordial deity who personifies the concepts of chaos and change. Padomay is always associated with its equal yet opposite force, Anu, and is heavily associated with the creation of the Aurbis.
Pale Lady is a vampire in who lives underneath Castle Skingrad. She feeds on prisoners in the Castle Skingrad Dungeon.
Pentarch Kovan Indoril is a Dunmer vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .

Phinis Gestor is a Breton mage found working and studying at the College of Winterhold. He can be found in the Hall of Countenance, but can also appear in The Arcanaeum. He is the college's expert-level Conjuration master and a former pupil of Falion. During a conversation with the Dragonborn, he admits to practicing Necromancy.

Potema Septim, also known as Potena, and the Wolf Queen, was a Queen of Solitude in Skyrim's hold of Haafingar during the Third Era. She was the daughter of Pelagius Septim II and Quintilla. Her efforts to claim the Ruby Throne resulted in the War of the Red Diamond, a lengthy and horrible war that devastated the Empire, turning it into a "land of death." Most of her Imperial family was killed, famines were widespread, and the war ended with the death of her and her lineage. Potema's actions during the war cemented her reputation as one of the most notable necromancers in the province's history, becoming one of the few historical figures to have been viewed by scholars as "unambiguously evil

Prince Adrien was a Breton noble, the son of King Eamond and Queen Arzhela as well as the legitimate heir to Evermore. He was recently killed in combat by Reachmen. On his way to his burial site in Pelin Graveyard, he was mysteriously brought back to life by Preinrha, a daedric harvester.
Prince Tarjal the Lost is a powerful Zombie found in the Tombs of the Na-Totambu.
Quendia is an Altmer necromancer. She takes part in conducting strange rituals with Eraman and Norendo at Soulfire Plateau.
Raelynn the Gravefinder is a Breton necromancer. She can be found in Moss Rock Cavern during the quest "The Gravefinder's Repose."
Raleth Eldri is a deceased Dunmer Conjurer who can be found in a tent outside the ruins of Kagrumez. It appears he was killed by Reavers, who then took his journal and headed into the Dwemer Ruins.
Rajdara the Restless One is a powerful Skeleton found inside the Ruins of Kardala.
Rala is a Dunmer vampire part of Valeric's coven. She is found in Wittestadr.

Raelynne Ashham is a Breton vampire originally hailing from Wayrest. She and her brother Gaston decided to move to Cyrodiil in the midst of the turmoil to found a vampire coven known as the Bloodborn. While he went to the Ayleid ruins of Lipsand Tarn with his associate Marbita, she settled in Underpall Cave. She is one of the two delve bosses of the cave.

Rakazsa is a Khajiit vampire found in the Weeping Scar. He is the current leader of the Tenarr Zalviit clan after the death of the previous Clan Mother. His blood-sister Yushiha was banished for challenging his rule.

Raxle Berne is an Imperial Enforcer in who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Galom Daeus. He is an Ancient vampire of the Clan Berne. If the Nerevarine is turned by another Berne vampire, he will provide some quests, as he considers them to be a mistake - albeit still of some use.
Ravate is a wizard who took part in a "contest of wills" with the Daedric Prince of Madness, Sheogorath.
Rayzara is a Dark Seducer and a spectator at the Maelstrom Arena.
Rathir, also known as Gravesinger, is a character in . He was a priest in Falkreath's Hall of the Dead, as well as a necromancer and a leader of the necromancy cult.
Reberio is an Imperial vampire who resides in Galom Daeus, along with the rest of the Clan Berne.
Reezal-Jul is an Argonian necromancer member of House Montclair. Influential formerly to King Ranser and then to Montclair, he is an influential player and manipulator of the nobles of Rivenspire.
Rexus Arvina is an Imperial member of the Mages Guild. He is the magister of their branch in Morkul Stronghold.
Roliand Hanus is an Imperial battlemage for the Mages Guild who is, alongside Arielle Jurard, investigating a rogue mage on the Gold Road.
Rogue Necromancer is a Dunmer necromancer residing in the Skygge ice cave west of Skaal Village.

Rosathild is a draugr necromancer found in The Howling Sepulchers in Craglorn. Previously she was one of the two bosses that needed to be defeated in order to clear the delve. She does not drop boss-level loot.

Saban is a Yokudan Redguard gypsy and powerful witchmother found in a camp north of Stros M'kai with her son, Coyle. After the tragic death of her eldest son Hayle, she paces the starstones ceaselessly chanting the Song of Passsage to prevent his soul from being ensnared by N'Gasta. Cyrus must help her in order to restore Prince A'Tor's. She can only speak in Old Yokudan.
Santinti Assarbeberib is a Dunmer Wise Woman who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Sapiarch Soraturil is an Altmer residing in Lillandril, Summerset. He is the Master of Psychocartography.
The Scrib is a creature in . It is the larval form of the Kwama. It is not very dangerous by itself; it can, however, paralyze its opponent.
Scent-of-Graves is an Argonian necromancer found dead at the ruins of Forelhost. He was part of the Worm Cult cell there. He is the author of the note Scent-of-Graves' Report.
Senilias Cadiusus is an Imperial Mage and warlock-level member of the Mages Guild who resides in the Dwemer Ruin of Nchuleftingth in Molag Amur.

Sees-Many-Paths is an Argonian mage and member of the Ebonheart Pact. She was sent to investigate the strange wards preventing access to the Tormented Spire. She is the egg-sister of Soft-Scale and Walks-in-Ash.
Sergius Turrianus is an Imperial enchanter working and living at the College of Winterhold.
Shadow Archer is a shadow creature in . Shadow Archers can be encountered inside Tribune's Folly in Gold Coast.
Shademother is a Hagraven that appears in . She can be found at her haven southwest of Morthal.
The Shadow of Sotha Sil is a character residing in the Clockwork Basilica. He has been masquerading as the real Sotha Sil for some time while Nocturnal extracted secrets from Seht's brain.
Shiri is a Redguard necromancer and leader of the Withered Hand. She serves as the hidden main antagonist of the Alik'r Desert region.
Sild the Warlock is a Nord necromancer residing in Rannveig's Fast.
Sihadid is a zombie that appears in . He is an undead Anka-Ra warrior found outside The Seeker's Archive.

The Skeleton is one of the creatures encountered in . Skeletons are animated by necromancy, a practice of magic that manipulates the dead. The skeleton has the same abilities and equipment as when the original owner was alive. Skeletons wield various equipment from claymores or axes to bows and may carry enchanted weapons.
Skirar the Decaying is a powerful mummy found in the ruins of Rulanyil's Fall.

Sir Valcent Tailies is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He led a squad of soldiers into the crypt at Bonestrewn Crest. Once inside, he turned on them and revealed himself to be a necromancer. He then proceeded to slay most of them and raise them as undead, as well as the draugr buried inside.
Songamdir is a werewolf packmaster in . He helps new werewolves.
Stonefire Battlemages are generic enemy battlemages in , and are members of the Stonefire Cult. They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a disguise.
Sulinus Vassinus is an Imperial spell merchant in the Skingrad Mages Guild. He also trains Apprentice level Conjuration.
General Talin Warhaft was a spellsword, leader of the Imperial Legion and personal bodyguard to Emperor Uriel Septim VII.
Tarhiel was a Bosmer Enchanter whose body may be found north of Seyda Neen.
Taviah Al-Thir is a conjurer and a member of Mages Guild. In , she gives a player the Mages Guild quests.
Thallik Wormfather is a Breton necromancer and the leader of the Order of the Black Worm in who resides in The Rift. He serves as the region's main antagonist.
Thalie the Voracious is an Altmer vampire found in the ruins of Molavar.
Thannar the Graveprowler is a Senche-raht necromancer world boss that appears at Scar's Edge in . He is attempting to raise an undead army.

The Caller is an Altmer mage and the leader of the mage faction at Fellglow Keep. She imprisoned Orthorn, after influencing him to steal the books regarding the Eye of Magnus. She is the tertiary antagonist of the College of Winterhold questline and the final boss of the quest "Hitting the Books."
The Exalted Viper is a Celestial trying to take the place of The Serpent in the sky. Her champion is Regent Cassipia. She serves as the main antagonist of the Craglorn region.
The Eternal One is a powerful wraith found in the Bonesnap Ruins.
The Grand Prognosticator is a Factotum residing in the Vale of Tiers in the Clockwork City. The residents of Slag Town often consult the Prognosticator to have their fortunes read.

The Prophet is an Imperial who arrives in Anvil after the Chapel of Dibella is attacked and everybody inside is killed. While the City Guard has no idea how the killers got in and out without being seen, the Prophet believes that they were the minions of Umaril the Unfeathered. The Prophet spends all day outside the chapel calling for a champion who can find and recover the Relics of the Crusader and stop Umaril.
The Rat Whisperer is a crazy Breton living in solitude in Wayrest Sewers I. He leads a large pack of rabid skeevers, granting him his name.
The Shade-Witch of Mournoth is a powerful Reachman member of the Dark Witnesses in . She is found inside The Hideaway.
The Sun King is a Nede spirit found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. He will summon two Spirit Soldiers to fight alongside him.
Tymvaul is a Nord necromancer who resides in the Skaal Village, and later in the cave of Rimhull.
Tsiniuc is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Daggerfall. He can assist the Vestige with summoning ghosts.
Uela is a hagraven in . She leads the Dark Witnesses' assault on northern Bangkorai. She communicates with the Vestige using Strange Crows.
Uldor is an undead Maormer wizard in the Temple of the Mourning Springs on the island of Khenarthi's Roost. He is the main antagonist of "Tears of the Two Moons."
Ureso Drath is a Dunmer enchanter and merchant who resides in the Ald'ruhn Temple. She is a novice-ranked member of the Tribunal Temple, and offers her services to the public.
Uulgarg the Risen is an undead skeleton boss found in Wayrest Sewers II in .
Uracaile the Graveborn is a Draugr raised by the Worm Cult members found in Vernim Woods.

Vampire Patriarch is a very strong Vampire in . There are eleven of them and they are the "fathers" of a band of vampires, similar to a Marauder Warlord. Having a high position, they are very well equipped with the highest quality armor, light or heavy and weapons of their level. Use caution when approaching, as they defend themselves well, and attack viciously. Like all vampires, they have a weakness to fire.

Vals Veran is a Dunmer necromancer who can be found at Hillgrund's Tomb, the resting place for Golldir's ancestors. He can be found in the final chamber of the tomb, along with a large number of draugr.
Vampire Archer is a Vampire in . There are three Vampire Archers, two males and one female.
The Vampire Necromancer is an enemy in . They appear in locations such as Ushmal's Rest, and are always hostile towards the Vestige.
Vath'ira is a Khajiit necromancer and a member of the Duneraider Bandits. She is found in the Lost City of the Na-Totambu.
Venissia the Twisted is a powerful Dark Seducer found within The Vile Manse.

Vingalmo is an Altmer vampire and member of the Volkihar Clan. He is one of Lord Harkon's primary advisors. He and fellow senior vampire Orthjolf are embroiled in a feud over the throne, and can be often heard making cutting remarks towards one another.
Vesta Illvina is a friendly skeleton residing at the Arvina Estate in Cyrodiil. She was resurrected by her husband Jaretius Illvina.

Volrina Quarra is an Imperial rogue, and vampire who resides in Morrowind. She resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Druscashti and is an Ancient of the Quarra Clan. If the Nerevarine becomes a vampire from another Quarra vampire, she will provides some quests, albeit reluctantly.
Voa was the archmage of the Stros M'Kai Mages Guild prior to the events of .

Vivien Armene is a Breton necromancer. She is desperately looking for the remains of ancient dragons for her to raise. She is hostile to anyone who dares approach the Dragon Mound she is currently excavating.

Volgo the Harrower is an Imperial necromancer of the Shadowed Path in who resides in Nisin Cave. He is one of the two bosses of the cave. Volgo has a chance to drop "The Harrower of Cyrodiil's Crest" Axe that is a part of the Crest of Cyrodiil set.
The Vosh Rakh Illusionist is a generic member of the Vosh Rakh found in the region of Wrothgar. They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a Disguise is worn.

Watcher Armok is an undead Nede found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. In order to seal Virmaril, who had betrayed his own people, Armok, Garalan and Shavmar sacrificed themselves and became his eternal watchers.

Whispering Lady is a voice behind a door in . Nelkir, the youngest son of Balgruuf the Greater, has been listening to her whispering. After talking to her, the Dragonborn discovers she is in fact a manifestation of the Daedric Prince Mephala.
Withered Hand Brutes are necromancers who can be found at the docks in Sentinel, Alik'r Desert.
The Worm Cult Necromancer is a generic member of the Order of the Black Worm. They operate all over Tamriel, serving the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, and his right-hand man, Mannimarco.
The Wizard of the Tower is an eccentric wizard residing in the hidden final room of the Wizard's Tower. Gavrus Lampronius asks you to look for him and tells you that his true name is Brold.
Yushiha is a Khajiit vampire found at the Moon Gate of Anequina.
Yx, Devourer of Souls is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses melee attacks.

Zombies are undead bodies resurrected by an unnatural spirit or necromancer. They are found in dark underground places, such as sewers and caves, and can also be found in graveyards. When slain, a zombie corpse may yield up mort flesh, which can be used as an alchemy ingredient. They are simple corpses filled with evil power to mindlessly do the bidding of their master. Sometimes zombies that were slaves of something are freed from the magical bonds binding them. These free zombies usually walk around, moaning and attacking nearby living creatures.
Bloss was a student at Watoga High School before the Great War. He became infamous for hacking the terminals in the computer science lab.
The Brain is an intelligent albino mole rat with an enlarged braincase, and the brother of Keeng Ra'at.
Bradley Ramone is a feral ghoul reaver found in the Commonwealth in 2287.

Deacon is a member of the Railroad and master of disguise, acting as a spy while performing field reconnaissance for their war against the Institute in the Commonwealth in 2287. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
Hadrian is a ghoul working as a stand-up comedian at the Atomic Wrangler Casino in 2281.
Harry Wilfred, known by his stage name Wilfred the Wizard, was a pre-War magician.
Jon Elwood (named in-game as Director) is a unique feral ghoul inhabiting Cambridge Polymer Labs in the Commonwealth .

Lillian Marie Bowen, typically truncated to Lily, is a nightkin and former assassin of the Master's Unity. By 2281, she resides in Jacobstown in the Mojave Wasteland, serving as the shepherd for the town's bighorner cattle. She is a possible companion of the Courier.
Masterbrain, formally known as the VTMB01 Masterbrain, is a unique robot inhabiting the former D.C. headquarters of the Vault-Tec Corporation in 2277.
Michael Masters is a ghoul residing in Warrington station in the year 2277.

Nightkin is a name for the elite super mutants of the Unity, created by the Master at Mariposa Military Base. The mutants were the apex of mutant development, corresponding with the Master's vision for the future of humanity. As the most successful examples of the transformation, nightkin considered exposure to FEV to be an unambiguous honor and a source of pride. They were provided with the finest equipment the Unity could muster, including Stealth Boys. The Master's death at the hands of the Vault Dweller and destruction of the Unity was a traumatic experience, scattering the nightkin across the West, relying on their stealth gear to evade pursuers. Their reliance on this stealth technolog
Bloomseer Poplar is the soothsayer of the Oasis Treeminders .

Randall Dean Clark (February 5, 2053 – January 23, 2124), known by the Sorrows tribe as the Father in the Caves, was a former United States Army serviceman who took refuge in Zion Canyon after living through the Great War, witnessing the creation of the wasteland and the harsh struggle for survival first-hand. His solitary existence and protection of the inhabitants of Zion against outside threats earned him a mythical stature among his wards, leading to his establishment as the Father in the Caves worshipped by the Sorrows for generations well into the 23rd century. His intermittent journal entries and camps scattered throughout Honest Hearts act as his autobiography. Beginning with the war
S.O.R.-1000 Beta is a robobrain guarding B.O.M.B.-001 in 2253.
Anna (aka the Archemist) is the apothecary of the Children of Atom at the Nucleus in 2287.

Thaddeus is a former aspirant of the Knights of San Fernando chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel and supporting character . Initially, he is a bully to his fellow Brotherhood member, Maximus, but then becomes his companion after Maximus assumes Knight Titus' identity. Eventually, Thaddeus starts transforming into some sort of mutant (he believes himself to be turning into a ghoul, but the mutations he receives imply this is not the case) and is forced to flee the Brotherhood as a result. Fleeing to the Mojave Wasteland, Thaddeus ends up reencountering Maximus and the Brotherhood, and subsequently joins him on his journey to New Vegas.
Vanessa Richards was a Mistress of Mystery of the Order of Mysteries.
Weedlings are mutated carnivorous plants found in the American Southwest. They are plant monsters that spawned as a result of the radioactive waste used to fertilize the crops.
ZAX is the outdated supercomputer machine intelligence in charge of The Great Calculation, the Boulder Dome installation, and research of the New Plague in 2253.

Aleria is a 29-year-old Clavat from Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Ring of Fates. She is the mother of the twins Yuri and Chelinka, and wife of their father Latov. She was once the royal court's leading practitioner of the crystal arts and was called the Starsinger.

The Arctic Wolf is a Water-elemental wolf enemy from Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank II Yarhi. In addition to its normal attack, Gnaw, the wolf may also use Silence Fang, which inflicts Silence and deals Water damage to one of its adversaries.

Ariadne is a non-playable character from Final Fantasy: The 4 Heroes of Light. She is an elf that was in love with Krinjh, but out of anger, she became the Sand Devil because she wanted to trap Krinjh in the desert.
Barbatos is a fiend in Final Fantasy X encountered Inside Sin. It is a large armored yellow/orange creature with short legs and big tube-like arms, which are used in battle as shields and hammers.
Battery Soldier is an enemy in Final Fantasy XV fought in imperial bases and various main quests. It is an imperial cybersoldier who wields a magitek firearm.
The Blue Flan is a Water-elemental enemy from Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank I Yarhi.
The Blue Wyrm is a Water-elemental enemy from Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank II Ranged Yarhi.

The Bog Witch, also known as the ToadLady, is an enemy in Final Fantasy IV. Her Croak summons Bog Toads to aid her. As she has no weaknesses, the best way to defeat her is with repeated weapon strikes. If the Bog Witch is killed, the Toads stop all actions. She is susceptible to Osmose, so if Rydia knows the spell, she can drain gratuitous amounts of MP from the Bog Witch to unleash her most powerful spells and summons throughout the Sylph Cave.

The Cetra, also known as the Ancients , are people from an ancient civilization frequently mentioned in the Final Fantasy VII series, although few Ancients are actually depicted in the games. The Cetra look identical to regular humans, but are deeply spiritual in nature. According to Sephiroth, regular humans are former Cetra who forsook their migratory nature to form permanent settlements millennia ago. The Cetra's special trait, which appears to be genetically passed on through their family line, is to interact with the lifestream and the planet in what some call "talking to the planet". Chaa Paqa the Profound is a Notorious Monster from Final Fantasy XI: Rise of the Zilart. He is encountered in Windurst Mission 6-2: Saintly Invitation, alongside Buu Xolo the Bloodfaced, Juu Zeni the Poisonmist, and Nuu Kofu the Gentle. Chaa Paqa will summon a Yagudo's Elemental to assist him, and will summon a Yagudo's Avatar upon using Astral Flow.

Judgemaster Cid is Mewt Randell's father from Final Fantasy Tactics Advance. In the fantasy world of Ivalice, he is the Judgemaster, leader of the Judges that enforce Ivalice's laws. While he can perform all of the duties of a normal judge, he also has the power to issue Advanced Laws, which can result in a Red Card for a character that takes any action forbidden by the Advanced Law.

Clionids are an enemy type in Final Fantasy XI. They tend to be very aggressive toward the Enlightened Races; however, they only initiate attacks at night, and prey especially upon weakened adventurers, seeking to destroy them quickly through devastating magic spells.

Garnet Til Alexandros XVII, alias Dagger and birth name Sarah, is a major character in Final Fantasy IX and the heir of Alexandria in the 17th generation. Garnet notices a change in her mother, Queen Brahne, and seeks to escape Alexandria Castle. Hiding her identity while traveling with Zidane, Garnet takes the alias Dagger, inspired by Zidane's weapon. Initially polite, soft spoken, and naive to the world outside of her castle, Garnet loosens up during her travels and becomes more streetwise. She resolves to use her powers as a summoner to protect her kingdom and becomes more assertive and less dependent on others for help. In battle, Dagger can use several Wht Mag spells and summon several

Ghido, also known as Gill, is a character from Final Fantasy V. He is an ancient sentient turtle who lives in a cave on Galuf's world, and is a sage known for his wisdom. Ghido offers his wisdom to the Light Warriors in their quest against Exdeath, but mocks those who are slow to catch on. Despite his age, Ghido is a capable fighter.
Imperial Beastmaster is an Imperial Army/Imperial Elite-type enemy in Final Fantasy XII found in the Sky Fortress Bahamut.

John Hardin is Sydney Losstarot's second-in-command of Müllenkamp in Vagrant Story. He is a 29-year-old tireless, faithful servant pushed to join the cult after the government betrayed him. Hardin possesses the power of spying on events far away. Though he seems to be a tough man caring only for his safety, he is loyal to Sydney, and despite a strained relationship, the two consider each other "friends". Hardin is said to have some powers to summon monsters, though it is never shown.
Keough is a resident of Doyleville who specializes in explosives. He appears in Final Fantasy VII The Kids Are Alright: A Turks Side Story.
Kum Kum , also known as Qumqum, is a recurring enemy in the Final Fantasy series. It is typically a ghostly wizard capable of casting powerful magic.

Lezaford is a character from Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift. An archmage known to many as the Runemaster, Lezaford is responsible for introducing the system of Laws and Judges to Ivalice hundreds of years ago. Luso relies on Lezaford's knowledge to get home and answer the questions of Jylland.
Marke is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is a specialist in matters of the occult dispatched by the Adventurers' Guild who appeared in the seasonal event All Saints' Wake in 2021.

The Miss Vamp is an undead Soul of Rebirth enemy in Final Fantasy II that references the Vampiress monster from Final Fantasy IV, as they share the same japanese name. Found in the Unknown Cave, she is not as powerful as her counterparts in the main game's world. While Miss Vamp's attacks do drain HP, their total HP is inferior to most enemies and they cannot cast any spells. Still, they give up a fair amount of gil when defeated.
The Necromancer, formerly called Necromancr and Necrmncr, is an enemy in Final Fantasy VI. It appears in the Phoenix Cave. It is advised to defeat them with Holy Waters.

Odium is a non-playable character that appears during the "Eureka" arc of Final Fantasy Dimensions II. He is the Prismatic God of Darkness in the land of Eureka, serving as a minor antagonist during the events of the arc.

Uttu is an enemy in Final Fantasy XV fought during main quests in Zegnautus Keep and in the Costlemark Tower maze. It is part of the archanid genus of daemons and appears as a quadrupedal spider with a torso of a woman. It can summon minions.
Edna "E" Mode is a major supporting character in The Incredibles and Incredibles 2. She is also a titular character of Auntie Edna.
The Omnidroids are characters in The Incredibles. They are a series of superhero-killing battle robots created by the supervillain Syndrome as part of Operation Kronos.

The Screenslaver is a secondary character in Incredibles 2. It is later revealed that he was just an average pizza delivery man under the control of Evelyn Deavor. Hypno-goggles were hidden in the eyepiece of the mask, allowing her to bend him to her will.
, Class Name , is a Ruler-class Pseudo-Servant in the body of Caren Hortensia summoned by Ritsuka Fujimaru during the Grand Orders of Fate/Grand Order.
is a Pict Fairy of Britain serving as one of the King Clan soldiers under Cnoc na Riabh in the British Lostbelt in Fate/Grand Order.

Selloi Dedona was an Oracle who escaped the Fall of the Twelve Colonies. She settled on New Caprica and continued her work during the Cylon Occupation. During that time she gave a message from God to a Number Three, revealing the survival of Hera.
Hades is a Kobolian Lord of Kobol responsible for the underworld. Hades was well admired by the people that colonised Canceron, and their capital city was named after him.
Messenger Leoben was a Messenger who took the form of a Number Two Humanoid Cylon to kill Cpt. Kara Thrace.

The Chitain are a warlike alien species native to Xerik-7, the only sentient race indigenous to the Xerik system. They are savage warriors with naturally armored bodies and poisonous bone-tipped tails, characterized by their serpentine lower bodies and scavenging culture. The Chitain establish alliances with the Cylons and engage in conflicts with both the Sky and the Colonial Fleet.

John de Lancie (born March 20, 1948 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania) is an American actor. De Lancie's filmography begins with several minor roles in now-classic 1970s television shows such as McMillan and Wife, The Six Million Dollar Man, Emergency!, and Barnaby Jones. For the first half of the 1980s, de Lancie had a regular role on the television soap, Days of Our Lives. His recurring role as the mysterious omnipotent alien being known only as "Q" in Star Trek: The Next Generation in 1987 greatly increased the actor's visibility and projects. is a Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Noel Niihashi. Ninny is also a singer in the band , having performed alongside Macy Baljure.
is a Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Ninny Spangcole.

Funjl is a mischievous mold pixie. He often lies and is now trapped in a jar. He appeared as the main antagonist in "The Moldy Touch," tricking Chowder to be his friend into putting mold on everything. Mung Daal once tried to use his mold, thinking it was spice. Funjl's only appearance was in this episode.
Grizznak Snompstork is a goblin "fartmage" (a sorcerer) from a special one-shot episode that used the Pathfinder system. Grizznak was played by Ivan Van Norman.
is a high elf sorcerer who spies for the Consortium of the Vermilion Dream.

is a human blood hunter who served as right hand to Claret Director Teresa Dulamar, of the Claret Orders in Tal'Dorei. Following Teresa's retirement, Jorick became her personal bodyguard. He has not appeared in Critical Role.
